## Outcome
Another lane's untracked `batch_state/atlas-jobs/receipts/*.json` must not refuse every dispatch. Issue listed 3 designs; implement **option 1**: guard allowlists untracked files under declared receipt collection points.

## Work
Find the clean-tree guard in `scripts/delegate.py` that refuses write-capable dispatch on untracked `batch_state/atlas-jobs/receipts/`. Allowlist that directory (and only documented receipt collection points already in `.gitignore` as tracked-by-design). Do not ignore the whole `batch_state/`. Test: untracked file under that receipts path does not fail the guard; a random untracked tracked-path still fails.

PR Refs #6967. Trailer `X-Agent: agy/infra-6967-receipt-allowlist`. Do not merge.

### Summary of Changes

Implemented **Option 1** for [#6967](https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/issues/6967):
- Allowlisted untracked files under declared receipt collection points (specifically `batch_state/atlas-jobs/receipts/`, unignored in `.gitignore` as tracked-by-design) in the [`scripts/delegate.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6967-receipt-allowlist/scripts/delegate.py) clean-tree guard (`_resolve_dirty_primary_checkout_error` and `_is_untracked_receipt_allowlisted`).
- Ensured non-receipt untracked files and tracked modifications (even under `batch_state/atlas-jobs/receipts/`) still fail the guard.
- Added comprehensive unit and end-to-end integration tests in [`tests/test_delegate.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6967-receipt-allowlist/tests/test_delegate.py).
